# Group of Infinity

> Group of Infinity is a Jodhpur-based service for chauffeur-driven Maruti Suzuki Swift car rentals and Rajasthani wedding photography across Rajasthan, India.

The business offers Swift cars for city travel, airport transfers, outstation trips and decorated wedding transport. Photography services include candid wedding photography, cinematic films, traditional ceremony coverage and pre-wedding shoots. Pricing is provided through a custom quote after the customer shares their date, location and requirements.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://groupofinfinity.art/): Overview of Swift rentals, wedding photography and combined packages.
- [Swift Car Rental](https://groupofinfinity.art/car-rental): Swift city rides, chauffeur service, outstation travel and decorated wedding cars.
- [Wedding Photography](https://groupofinfinity.art/photography): Photography services, portfolio, packages and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://groupofinfinity.art/about): Information about the Group of Infinity team and service area.
- [Contact](https://groupofinfinity.art/contact): Booking enquiry and contact options.

## Service Area

- Jodhpur, Rajasthan
- Services are available across Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer, Bikaner, Ajmer, Pushkar and Mount Abu.

- [Sitemap](https://groupofinfinity.art/sitemap.xml): List of indexable site pages.

## Important Notes

- The current rental fleet consists of Maruti Suzuki Swift cars.
- Rental pricing depends on the route, duration, date and decoration requirements.
- Customers should use the official contact page to confirm availability and receive a quote.
